reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by cmdk (https://github.com/dip/cmdk).
Technology stack: react, typescript, radix-ui.
Component specification: 最后看原演示页源码。Framer、Linear、Vercel、Raycast 四套命令菜单。
Key visual & interaction patterns: 命令面板、Combobox.
Visual details from source observation: cmdk.paco.me 与 cmdk.vercel.app 都跳到 github.com/dip/cmdk，原演示站没了。README 大图写 Fast, unstyled, composable command menu，v1.1.1。ARCHITECTURE 讲组合式 combobox，不要数组 map。website/pages/index.tsx 是原演示源码，含 Raycast、Linear、Vercel、Framer 四套皮。适合要 ⌘K 面板、样式自己写的人。MIT。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
